messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@olivetech.com>

Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@olivetech.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace addendum redlines (attached)

Hi Camila / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Olive Tech is excited to move the Redwood listing forward. Attached are the addendum redlines from our procurement and legal teams ("OliveTech_Marketplace_Addendum_redline_v2.docx") plus a short compare PDF. A few quick items we need to resolve before we can finalize the Order Form: 

- Pass-through fee language: we need explicit language that fees charged by the cloud marketplace (listing fees, transaction fees) are passed through to Olive Tech, and where Redwood remains the billed vendor.
- Audit & evidence: our finance team requires 24 months of invoice-level evidence and the right to audit billing flow (limited to marketplace transactions).
- Effective date / termination: clarify which date governs billing for marketplace-listed SKUs and whether termination affects outstanding pass-throughs.

Are you able to confirm a timeline for Redwood's legal redline response and whether you need our procurement team on a quick call? We are targeting signature by June 3 to meet our internal launch.

Attachments: OliveTech_Marketplace_Addendum_redline_v2.docx (redline), redlines_compare_20270524.pdf (summary)

Best,
Samir

Samir — thanks for the redlines and the compare doc. We appreciate the clarity on the must-haves. High level plan from our side: 

1) Legal triage (Karthik) — review substantive commercial/legal asks (pass-through, audit scope, termination). Target initial comments back to you by EOD 2027-05-27.
2) Commercial alignment (Ben) — confirm how pass-through will show up on our invoices and whether it requires order form language changes.
3) Finance confirmation (Laura) — validate 24-month evidence availability and whether we can meet audit scope limits.

Can you confirm whether Olive Tech is ok with a single consolidated redline (our preferred route) or you want line-item responses back against each of your edits? Also, if Procurement/Maya could be available for a 30-min sync Wed 5/26 9–11am PT that would help clear questions quickly.

We will include an internal ops checklist so running the marketplace listing and the billing flow are coordinated. I’ll send a short schedule once Karthik confirms the legal window.

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace addendum redlines (attached)

FYI — quick notes from my triage after reading Olive Tech's redline: 

On Tue, May 25, 2027 at 10:08 AM Samir Patel <samir.patel@olivetech.com> wrote:
> (original message and attachments)

My inline flags: 
- Pass-through clause (Section 3.2 in their edit): Acceptable if we add language that Redwood remains the vendor of record and will invoice Olive Tech directly for consumption charges; marketplace fees will be itemized and pass-through only where we actually incur a third-party marketplace charge. Suggest: limit to \"direct marketplace fees\" and exclude marketplace promotional credits or rebates.
- Audit language (Section 7): Too broad. Propose: limit to one audit per 12 months, scoped to marketplace invoice reconciliation only, with a 30-day notice window and Redwood's right to use redacted data for vendor invoices.
- Indemnity/cap: Ensure any new pass-through wording doesn't expand indemnity footprint. Keep liability cap tied to fees paid under the Order Form for the prior 12 months.
- Effective date/termination: We should add a run-off clause for marketplace fees invoiced within 60 days of termination.

Action items: 
- Ben: draft proposed invoice wording that shows how pass-throughs will be itemized (example invoice stub) — target 5/26 morning.
- Laura: confirm we can produce transaction-level evidence for past 24 months and whether redaction is allowed — target 5/26 EOD.
- Camila: confirm if Olive wants consolidated redline vs line-by-line (Samir asked).

I will prepare a marked-up redline (word track) and a short memo on audit limits. Planning to circulate to Samir once Ben/Laura confirm.

-Karthik
Associate General Counsel, Redwood

From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@olivetech.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@olivetech.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 17:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum redlines (attached) — proposed handoff and timeline

Samir / Maya — thanks for the patience while we reviewed internally. Quick update and proposed schedule to keep to your June 3 target: 

- We will produce a consolidated redline (single Word file) that addresses your edits and includes our proposed language for pass-throughs and audit limits. Karthik will annotate the high-risk legal points.
- Ben will attach a sample invoice stub showing pass-through line items and where marketplace fees will appear (no separate third-party billing).
- Laura confirms we can provide invoice-level evidence for 24 months and supports a one-audit-per-12-months limit with reasonable redaction.

Proposed delivery: consolidated redline + sample invoice + short memo by EOD Monday 2027-05-31. If that works for Olive Tech, we can schedule a 30-min call Tues 6/1 to run through open items and finalize for signature the week of 6/1–6/4.

Attachments: redlines_compare_20270524.pdf (from your side), internal_checklist_marketplace_onboarding.xlsx (ops checklist — we'll share via Drive link).

If Olive prefers to receive line-by-line responses instead, please let me know by EOD 5/26; otherwise we'll proceed with a consolidated redline.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Camila Reyes
